name: Environment Monitor Device
description: Environment monitoring of carbon dioxide, temperature, and humidity in room and record trends in environment.

name: Environment Monitor Android App
description: An android app that provision data to environment monitor device and display environment data.

name: Environment Monitor Server
description: Self-hosted private server that collect data from environment monitor device and stores it in a PostgreSQL database. Supports multiple environment monitor devices.

name: Procedural Generation Tile Constraints
description: Procedural generation implementation using constraints based on Model Synthesis by Paul Merrell and Wave Function Collapse by Maxim Gumin.

name: Quadtree A*
description: Finding a pathfinding solution on large grids by building quadtree, building graph, and A* search.
